meta.abstraction: Finite user-visible projection of sampled valid traces; merged predicates may over-approximate combinations of hidden preconditions. This is not exhaustive model checking.

meta.description: The person is opening the multiplayer view.
checks: No final outcome is claimed before the opening result.

meta.description: The person is choosing a multiplayer time control.
checks: Every game has two distinct people and fixed colours.
One person cannot have two unfinished games or look for an opponent during one.
A winner is one of the two people, nobody moves once a game is over, only a game in which both people have not yet moved is aborted, and nobody wins a game before both people have moved.
Every search and game has an offered time control; a rematch follows a finished game with the same time control and the colours swapped.
Of two matched people, the one with the greater colour balance plays Black; a colour balance counts finished games only.
Neither clock runs before both first moves, a clock never holds more than its time plus the increments earned, and a clock at zero lost.
Each finished game counts once toward both people's rated multiplayer games at its speed; an aborted game counts for nobody.
A draw offer belongs to one of the two people of an unfinished game; a rematch offer to one of the two people of a finished game both still have.
Online devices show the same accepted game, colour, board, clocks, offers, search, result and rated games.
Offline devices keep their last known board, clocks, offers and search until returning.
Deleted accounts never keep searching or reach a private game on return.
Bookkeeping: games are bounded here to eight accepted moves.
meta.projectionReview: Confirm that omitted data do not enable an impossible stitched path.
